title: HelperCraft
description: This mod adds items that execute commands when you right-click (RMB). Instead of typing commands, you can simply use special items to trigger actions instantly, making gameplay faster and easier.
body:
This mod adds 38 unique items that replace traditional command input with simple right-click actions, making gameplay faster, easier, and more dynamic. Instead of typing commands, players can trigger powerful effects instantly using special items.
The mod includes time control items such as acceleration, slowdown, and base-time reset, allowing full control over the flow of the world. There are also day and night switching items that let you instantly change the environment.
Combat and utility items are also added. A one-hit kill sword gives extreme power in close combat, while special arrows can destroy blocks on impact. A lightning item can summon strikes anywhere, creating chaos or strategic attacks. Two levels of explosion items are included, ranging from small blasts to massive destruction.
For survival and experimentation, the mod introduces a potion of instant death, along with other experimental effects. Players can also use items to switch game modes quickly, similar to creative, survival, and other modes, without typing any commands.
Overall, this mod transforms command-based mechanics into a simple item-based system. Every action becomes accessible through items, making it perfect for creative gameplay, chaos servers, or fast testing worlds where speed and simplicity matter most.
